issues.where: the broad far crater wall from the upper rim down the right side
issues.what: the ledges repeat the same scalloped shelves, dark undercuts and vertically smeared grooves over much of the shot, so the wall reads like a molded surface rather than broken strata
issues.fix: vary the fracture patterns and shelf spacing, break up the continuous undercuts and replace the stretched wall detail with scale-correct rock texture

issues.where: top-left and top-right crops, along the backlit rust-colored fronds
issues.what: the finest strands resolve into stepped cutouts and rectangular clumps; several smooth, dark stem strips end abruptly above them
issues.fix: use actual strands at the hero distance and improve coverage filtering on finer strands; taper and join the stems naturally

issues.where: right crop, where the pale stones sit against the darker slope
issues.what: the stones have faceted contours and abruptly intersect the slope without a readable contact shadow or sediment around the edges
issues.fix: seat the stones into the slope, break up the intersection with small scree and add localized contact shading

issues.where: the right half of the ravine, just under the distant wall
issues.what: a broad beige band has a conspicuously straight top and flattens everything beneath it into a similar tint
issues.fix: break the top edge into drifting volumes at different depths, with light and density varying around the terrain

issues.where: bottom-right crop, around the base of the left-hand foliage
issues.what: many bright spray flecks are near-identical squares or short dashes, with little variation in translucency or softness
issues.fix: vary droplet size, focus and streak length by depth and motion, and tie the denser spray to a visible source
